about.heading: About our overseas education
paragraphs: We counsel students about education opportunities in other countries and help them get there, from choosing a course to landing at their university.
Wayfarer began in 2011. Since then, students from Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune and Kochi have come to us for admissions, education loans and student visas.
Over the years we have added test coaching, visit visas and immigration services. Read about our mission, our values and how we work.

services.heading: One-stop destination for your study abroad needs

how.heading: How Wayfarer works
